cases.sentence: «Ну скажи же, пожалуйста, что ты делал за границей? Где был?» — сказал Степан Аркадьевич, когда ___ вышел.
cases.translation: "Now tell me, please, what were you doing abroad? Where were you?" said Stepan Arkadyich, when the peasant had gone out.
cases.explain: Мужик is the grammatical subject of the verb вышел, so it stands in the nominative case.

cases.sentence: У Левина... у нового своего ___, только что поступившего на это высшее место и ревизовавшего Москву.
cases.translation: At Levin's... at his new superior's, who had just taken this high post and was inspecting Moscow.
cases.explain: The preposition у always governs the genitive case, so начальника is required here.

cases.sentence: Он обещался, что приедет к последнему ___ и свезет ее ужинать.
cases.translation: He promised that he would come for the last act and take her to supper.
cases.explain: The preposition к governs the dative case, so акт becomes акту.

cases.sentence: Из театра Степан Аркадьевич заехал в охотный ряд, сам выбрал ___ и спаржу к обеду.
cases.translation: From the theater Stepan Arkadyich stopped by the game market and personally picked out fish and asparagus for dinner.
cases.explain: Рыба is the direct object of the transitive verb выбрал, so it takes the accusative form рыбу.

cases.sentence: Он распахнул пальто, но потом снял его и просидел целый час, разговаривая с ___ об охоте и о самых задушевных предметах.
cases.translation: He threw open his coat, but then took it off and sat for a whole hour, chatting with Levin about hunting and the most heartfelt subjects.
cases.explain: The preposition с ("with") requires the instrumental case, giving Левиным.

cases.sentence: У Дюссо ему нужно было быть у троих, всех трех, как на его счастье, стоявших в одной ___.
cases.translation: At Dusseaux's he had to visit all three of them, who, luckily for him, were staying in the same hotel.
cases.explain: The preposition в expressing location takes the prepositional case, so гостиница becomes гостинице.

reading.question: What day was it, the day after the events at the start of the chapter?
reading.explain: The text opens: "На другой день было воскресенье" ("The next day was Sunday").

reading.ru: Степан Аркадьевич заехал в Большой театр на репетицию балета и передал Маше Чибисовой хорошенькой, вновь поступившей по его протекции танцовщице, обещанной накануне корольки.
reading.question: Why did Stepan Arkadyich stop at the Bolshoi Theater?
options: To deliver candied fruit to a young dancer he had helped get a position
reading.correct: To deliver candied fruit to a young dancer he had helped get a position
reading.explain: He gave Masha Chibisova, a dancer placed there through his patronage, the sugared fruit he had promised her the day before.

reading.ru: Объяснив ей, что ему нельзя быть к началу балета, он обещался, что приедет к последнему акту и свезет ее ужинать.
reading.question: What arrangement did Stepan Arkadyich make with the dancer?
options: To come for the last act and take her to supper
To meet her the next morning
reading.correct: To come for the last act and take her to supper
reading.explain: He explained he could not be there for the start, but would come for the last act and take her to supper.

reading.ru: Из театра Степан Аркадьевич заехал в охотный ряд, сам выбрал рыбу и спаржу к обеду, и в 12 часов был уже у Дюссо, где ему нужно было быть у троих, всех трех, как на его счастье, стоявших в одной гостинице.
reading.question: Where did Stepan Arkadyich go after the theater, and why?
options: To the game market to choose food, then to a hotel to see three men he needed to invite to dinner
reading.correct: To the game market to choose food, then to a hotel to see three men he needed to invite to dinner
reading.explain: He picked fish and asparagus for dinner, then went to Dusseaux's hotel where Levin, his new superior, and Karenin were all staying.

reading.ru: Степан Аркадьевич любил пообедать, но еще более любил дать обед, небольшой, но утонченный, и по еде, и питью, и по вывору гостей.
reading.question: What did Stepan Arkadyich enjoy even more than eating a good dinner?
options: Hosting a small, refined dinner party
reading.correct: Hosting a small, refined dinner party
reading.explain: He loved dining well, but loved even more to give a dinner, small but refined in food, drink, and choice of guests.

reading.ru: Будут окуни живые, спаржа, и главное блюдо – чудесный, но простой ростбиф и сообразные вины.
reading.question: What was the planned main course of the dinner?
reading.explain: The text lists live perch, asparagus, and as the main dish a wonderful but simple roast beef with suitable wines.

reading.ru: А из гостей будут Китти и Левин, и, чтобы незаметно это было, будет еще Кузина и Щербацкий молодой.
reading.question: Who were among the guests invited, aside from Kitty and Levin?
options: A cousin and young Shcherbatsky, to make it less obvious
reading.correct: A cousin and young Shcherbatsky, to make it less obvious
reading.explain: To keep the pairing of Kitty and Levin inconspicuous, a cousin and young Shcherbatsky were also invited.

reading.ru: Да позовет еще известного чудака-энтузиаста Песцова, либерала, говоруна, музыканта, историка и милейшего 50-летнего юношу, который будет соус или гарнир Кознышеву и Каренину.
reading.question: How is Pestsov described?
options: An eccentric enthusiast, liberal, talker, musician, and historian
reading.correct: An eccentric enthusiast, liberal, talker, musician, and historian
reading.explain: Pestsov is called a well-known eccentric enthusiast: a liberal, a talker, a musician, a historian, and a delightful man of fifty.

reading.ru: Долли была очень мила и добра последнее время, и мысль этого обеда во всех отношениях радовала Степана Аркадьевича.
reading.question: How had Dolly been behaving toward Stepan Arkadyich recently?
reading.explain: Dolly had been very sweet and kind lately, which pleased Stepan Arkadyich about the dinner plan.

reading.ru: Первое то, что вчера он, встретив на улице Алексея Александровича, заметил, что он сух и строг с ним, и, сведя это выражение лица Алексея Александровича и то, что он не приехал к ним и не дал знать о себе, с теми толками, которые он слышал об Анне и Вронском, Степан Аркадьевич догадывался, что что-то неладно между мужем и женою.
reading.question: What made Stepan Arkadyich suspect something was wrong between Karenin and Anna?
options: Karenin's coldness in the street, his silence, and rumors about Anna and Vronsky
Karenin openly told him about a divorce
reading.correct: Karenin's coldness in the street, his silence, and rumors about Anna and Vronsky
reading.explain: Karenin's dry, strict manner, his failure to visit, and the gossip about Anna and Vronsky led Stepan Arkadyich to suspect trouble.

reading.ru: Другое, немножко неприятное, было то, что новый начальник, как все новые начальники, имел уж репутацию страшного человека, встающего в шесть часов утра, работающего как лошадь и требующего такой же работы от подчиненных.
reading.question: What reputation did the new superior have?
options: A terrifying man who rose at six, worked like a horse, and demanded the same of subordinates
reading.correct: A terrifying man who rose at six, worked like a horse, and demanded the same of subordinates
reading.explain: Like all new superiors, he had a reputation of being a fearsome man who got up at six, worked tirelessly, and expected the same from his staff.

reading.ru: Левин стоял с тверским мужиком посредине номера и мерил аршином свежую медвежью шкуру, когда вошел Степан Аркадьевич.
reading.question: What was Levin doing when Stepan Arkadyich entered his hotel room?
options: Measuring a fresh bear hide with a peasant from Tver
reading.correct: Measuring a fresh bear hide with a peasant from Tver
reading.explain: Levin was in the middle of the room with a peasant from Tver, measuring a fresh bearskin with an arshin.

reading.ru: Ведь весь этот мир наш — это маленькая плесень, которая наросла на крошечной планете.
reading.question: What philosophical image does Levin use to describe the world?
options: A tiny mold that has grown on a minuscule planet
reading.correct: A tiny mold that has grown on a minuscule planet
reading.explain: Levin describes their whole world as a small mold that has formed on a tiny planet, reflecting on mortality.

reading.ru: Он слышал, что она была в начале зимы в Петербурге у своей сестры, жены дипломата, и не знал, вернулась ли она или нет, но раздумал расспрашивать.
reading.question: What did Levin want to ask about, but decided against?
options: Whether Kitty had returned from visiting her sister in Petersburg
reading.correct: Whether Kitty had returned from visiting her sister in Petersburg
reading.explain: Levin wanted to ask about Kitty, having heard she'd been in Petersburg with her sister, but he thought better of asking.

reading.ru: И Степан Аркадьевич позавтракал с ним и засиделся так, что только в четвертом часу попал к Алексею Александровичу.
reading.question: What happened after Stepan Arkadyich went to meet the new superior?
options: He argued with him and left quickly
He had breakfast with him and stayed so long he only reached Karenin's after three o'clock
He was fired on the spot
reading.correct: He had breakfast with him and stayed so long he only reached Karenin's after three o'clock
reading.explain: He breakfasted with the new chief and lingered so long that he only got to Alexei Alexandrovich's after three o'clock.
